format: WSDC Registry Events, Jack and Jill random and unbiased selection

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Jack and Jill contests 'must maintain the integrity of random and unbiased selection (i.e., rotating partners, pairing of partners, and music selection)'; partner rotation in prelims and partner selection in finals 'should be random'; a computerized scoring system 'should' randomly assign partners and place paired competitors in random dance order.

requirement: A WSDC profile must keep partner rotation, pairing and music selection random and unbiased; this concerns partners and music, NOT heat sizing or grouping.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body's scoring profile. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: planner, SQL, UI changes.
interpretation_notes: The overarching duty is 'must'; the examples ('should be random') and Section 6 items ('should') are softer. The text does not tie this to heat size, balance or grouping of competitors into heats. Partner rotation is not modelled in DanceFlow at all. Note: source.effective_from is not stated in the source registry; it follows the convention of sibling entries.
